title: answerdesk grounded answer draft
description: Structured-output schema for the grounded generation prompt. Every object is closed (additionalProperties: false) and every property is required, so the schema is valid for OpenAI-style strict json_schema mode and for local servers that validate against it.

insufficient_evidence.description: true when the evidence cannot answer the question; claims must then be empty.

why.description: Short explanation when insufficient_evidence is true; empty string otherwise.

claims.description: Ordered atomic claims; empty when insufficient_evidence is true.

text.description: One atomic assertion, in the customer's language.

passage.description: Evidence label exactly as printed in the prompt (p1, p2, …).

quote.description: Verbatim substring of that passage; copied character-for-character.
